panel.name: instances_section

check_box.label: Show ghosts
check_box.name: show_all_check
check_box.tool_tip: Master visibility: hide every ghost at once without losing the per-ghost enables. Session-only

panel.text: Styled copies of cast bodies: place, pose, multiply. Double-click a clone to show/hide; double-click a group to expand

check_box.label: Edit ghosts
check_box.name: edit_ghosts_check
check_box.tool_tip: Edit ghosts in world: click a ghost to select it, drag to move it on the ground, Shift-drag to turn it, click empty ground to re-place the selection, Delete removes it. Esc (or unchecking) hands the camera back. Spinners below stay the precision path

scroll_list.name: ghost_list
scroll_list.tool_tip: Every ghost and crowd group. Double-click a clone to toggle visibility; double-click a group header to expand or collapse its individually positionable members. Ghosts keep rendering when their source avatar is off-camera or impostored; freeze to lock a pose

combo_box.name: source_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Whose body the new ghost copies: you, or any cast member

combo_box.name: clone_type_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Persistent type for newly added ghosts

button.label: Add
button.name: btn_ghost_add
button.tool_tip: Add the selected clone type from the chosen source

button.label: Duplicate
button.name: btn_ghost_dup
button.tool_tip: Copy the selected ghost (including a frozen pose) one step to its left

button.label: Delete
button.name: btn_ghost_del
button.tool_tip: Remove the selected ghost

button.label: Refresh
button.name: btn_ghost_refresh
button.tool_tip: Re-sync this entity clone to its source's current appearance and worn attachments

line_editor.label: Name
line_editor.name: ghost_name
line_editor.tool_tip: Session-only ghost name. Duplicate names are allowed; identity remains the internal instance id

spinner.label: X
spinner.name: pos_x_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Ghost foot position, region coordinates (m)

spinner.label: Y
spinner.name: pos_y_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Ghost foot position, region coordinates (m)

spinner.label: Z
spinner.name: pos_z_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Ghost foot height, region coordinates (m)

spinner.label: Yaw (deg)
spinner.name: yaw_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Exact ghost heading in degrees; stays synchronized with the live heading dial

button.name: reset_yaw
button.tool_tip: Reset yaw to default

compass_dial.name: heading_dial
compass_dial.tool_tip: Ghost heading: drag the needle to rotate the selected ghost live; mouse wheel trims 5 degrees per click

spinner.label: Scale
spinner.name: scale_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Uniform size or group scale factor; the live tooltip reports the exact allowed group range

button.name: reset_scale
button.tool_tip: Reset scale to default

button.label: Place (click ground)
button.name: btn_place
button.tool_tip: Arm one ground click: the next click on ground/prim puts the ghost's feet there. Esc or right-click cancels

button.label: To actor
button.name: btn_to_actor
button.tool_tip: Snap the ghost onto its source's current feet

button.label: To me
button.name: btn_to_me
button.tool_tip: Snap the ghost onto your avatar's current feet

combo_box.name: look_target_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Aim at the camera, you, a Director cast member, or another Ghost Studio instance

button.label: Face now
button.name: btn_face_now
button.tool_tip: Turn the selected ghost toward the chosen target once

check_box.label: Keep facing
check_box.name: keep_facing_check
check_box.tool_tip: Per-instance continuous tracking; re-aims on each viewer idle tick. Turning it off leaves the last heading

button.label: Drop to ground
button.name: btn_drop_ground
button.tool_tip: Set each selected ghost's feet to the viewer land height beneath it

button.label: Align feet
button.name: btn_align_feet
button.tool_tip: Put all selected ghosts on the first selected ghost's Z plane

button.label: Upright
button.name: btn_reset_upright
button.tool_tip: Clear pitch and roll while keeping each selected ghost's yaw

button.label: Duplicate here
button.name: btn_duplicate_in_place
button.tool_tip: Create a new ghost at exactly the selected ghost's transform

button.label: Copy transform
button.name: btn_copy_transform
button.tool_tip: Copy foot position, full rotation, and scale to the session clipboard

button.label: Paste transform
button.name: btn_paste_transform
button.tool_tip: Paste foot position, full rotation, and scale to every selected ghost

panel.name: style_scroll_body
panel.text: Style options apply to overlay ghosts. Entity clones use the avatar/deferred path and inherit their source appearance.

combo_box.name: style_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Overlay render look. Includes clean spectral, textured FX, graphic, material, and animated spectral styles; all honor the instance hue, alpha, pixelate, shimmer, glitch, and brightness controls.

combo_box.name: distort_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Independent distortion layer. Stacks with any selected look.

check_box.label: Actor hue
check_box.name: actor_tint_check
check_box.tool_tip: Tint from the source's stable path color (matches its path/ghost hue). Uncheck to pick a hue with the slider

slider.label: Hue
slider.name: hue_slider
slider.tool_tip: Tint hue (degrees) when Actor hue is off

button.name: reset_hue
button.tool_tip: Reset hue to default

button.name: reset_alpha
button.tool_tip: Reset alpha to default

slider.label: Pixelate
slider.name: pixel_slider
slider.tool_tip: Screen-space pixelation block size (px). 0 = off. Reads strongest on the Clone style

button.name: reset_pixel
button.tool_tip: Reset pixelation to default

slider.label: Shimmer Hz
slider.name: shimmer_speed_slider
slider.tool_tip: Shimmer speed (wobbles per second); only matters when Amount is above 0

button.name: reset_shimmer_speed
button.tool_tip: Reset shimmer speed to default

slider.label: Amount
slider.name: shimmer_amount_slider
slider.tool_tip: Shimmer depth: brightness/alpha wobble, phase-offset per ghost so crowds do not strobe together. 0 = off

button.name: reset_shimmer_amount
button.tool_tip: Reset shimmer amount to default

slider.label: Glitch
slider.name: glitch_slider
slider.tool_tip: Broken-signal effect: horizontal slices tear sideways with a chroma split. 0 = off

button.name: reset_glitch
button.tool_tip: Reset glitch to default

slider.label: Distort amt
slider.name: distort_amount_slider
slider.tool_tip: Strength of the selected independent distortion

button.name: reset_distort_amount
button.tool_tip: Reset distortion amount

slider.label: Brightness
slider.name: brightness_slider
slider.tool_tip: Output brightness: the ghost is unlit, so a clone reads fullbright in a night scene. Dial down (~0.3-0.5) to sit it into dark sets; 1 = as authored

button.name: reset_brightness
button.tool_tip: Reset brightness to default

spinner.label: Effect fps
spinner.name: effect_fps_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Per-clone shader animation cadence. 0 is smooth; 1-30 holds animated looks and distortions for stop motion. Separate from Pose fps.

button.name: reset_effect_fps
button.tool_tip: Reset Effect fps to smooth

panel.name: pose_section

button.label: Grab pose now
button.name: btn_freeze
button.tool_tip: FREEZE: snapshot the source's current pose into this ghost (worn mesh + attachment placement). The ghost holds it while the live body keeps animating. Known limits: flexi tails/skirts keep their live physics motion, and legacy system-mesh eyeballs are not part of the ghost

button.label: Follow live
button.name: btn_live
button.tool_tip: Drop the frozen pose; the ghost mirrors the source's live animation again

check_box.label: Hold on source change
check_box.name: mirror_hold_check
check_box.tool_tip: MIRROR mode: keep clones playing their last bento + animesh animation through a transient source change (outfit re-rez, brief de-rez, out-of-view imposter, or AO gap) instead of stopping. A real switch to a different animation still mirrors normally. Off = faithful live mirror (a source change or full stop stops the clone too).

combo_box.name: drive_mode_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Entity animation drive: mirror its source, play a local animation asset, or hold the current pose

check_box.label: Chaos
check_box.name: chaos_check
check_box.tool_tip: Deterministic per-clone position, yaw and uniform-scale variation

slider.name: chaos_slider
slider.tool_tip: Chaos amount (0..1); stable for this clone's instance id

button.name: reset_chaos
button.tool_tip: Reset chaos amount to default

combo_box.name: entity_look_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Client-only entity render look. Apparition is scaffolded this pass; advanced shaders are deferred

spinner.label: Anim Speed
spinner.name: anim_speed_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Per-clone animation speed relative to scene tempo. Chaos adds a stable variation of up to plus/minus 15 percent

button.name: reset_anim_speed
button.tool_tip: Reset animation speed to default

check_box.label: Physics
check_box.name: physics_check
check_box.tool_tip: Breast, belly and butt physics for each selected entity clone. Physics is calculated separately per clone; disable it for large crowds to reduce CPU cost

combo_box.name: anim_loop_mode_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Loop re-triggers the clone-owned motion on completion; Play once lets it stop at the end. This does not rewrite baked asset metadata

button.label: Pause
button.name: btn_anim_pause
button.tool_tip: Hold each selected entity clone at its current motion time. This is the existing Frozen drive state

button.label: Resume
button.name: btn_anim_resume
button.tool_tip: Resume each selected clone in the Mirror or Directed mode it used before pausing

button.label: Sync
button.name: btn_anim_sync
button.tool_tip: Restart all selected clones together without changing speed, pause or drive mode

combo_box.name: animation_library_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Animations in your own inventory only. Metadata loads asynchronously. Use Refresh after adding animations to inventory

button.label: Refresh
button.name: btn_anim_library_refresh
button.tool_tip: Re-scan your inventory for animations. The list is not polled automatically

line_editor.label: Animation UUID
line_editor.name: directed_anim_editor
line_editor.tool_tip: Animation asset UUID played only on the selected entity clone; direct UUID paste remains supported

check_box.label: This actor
check_box.name: lens_gaze_check
check_box.tool_tip: Client-only post-blend head, neck and eye tracking toward the render camera. Continues while the clone animation is frozen; camera-on-head feedback interlocks suppress it

button.label: Enable selected
button.name: btn_lens_gaze_selection
button.tool_tip: Enable camera gaze for every selected entity clone; overlay ghosts are ignored

slider.label: Torso
slider.name: lens_gaze_torso
slider.tool_tip: Torso share for selected entity clones. 0 keeps the chest still; 1 lets the torso take the full gaze turn

button.name: reset_lens_gaze_torso
button.tool_tip: Reset torso gaze to default

combo_box.name: lens_gaze_target_mode
combo_box.tool_tip: Per-clone gaze target: travel tangent, render camera, a Director cast member, or the stored world point

combo_box.name: lens_gaze_cast_target
combo_box.tool_tip: Director cast member used by Cast target mode

slider.label: Head / eyes
slider.name: lens_gaze_head_eye
slider.tool_tip: 0 uses eyes only; 1 gives the head and neck their full share

button.name: reset_lens_gaze_head_eye
button.tool_tip: Reset head and eye gaze to default

button.name: reset_lens_gaze_intensity
button.tool_tip: Reset gaze intensity to default

button.name: reset_lens_gaze_smoothing
button.tool_tip: Reset gaze smoothing to default

panel.text_editor: Select an entity clone to inspect rig and per-face texture state.

panel.name: array_section

spinner.label: Count
spinner.name: array_count_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Total clones in the crowd, including the selected prototype

button.name: reset_array_count
button.tool_tip: Reset copy count to default

spinner.label: Spacing
spinner.name: array_spacing_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Minimum centre-to-centre spacing in metres

button.name: reset_array_spacing
button.tool_tip: Reset spacing to default

button.label: Line
button.name: btn_array_line
button.tool_tip: Choose Line and immediately preview it in world

button.label: Ring
button.name: btn_array_ring
button.tool_tip: Choose Ring and immediately preview it in world

combo_box.name: array_formation_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Choose a precise crowd formation; the controls below adapt to this shape

combo_box.name: crowd_copies_as_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Crowd copies keep the selected prototype's backing type

combo_box.name: formation_guide_shape_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Optional visual guide only; it never clips, squeezes, or removes clone slots

spinner.label: Size
spinner.name: formation_guide_size_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Circle radius or square half-size in metres; a visual measuring guide, not a placement limit

check_box.label: Snap each to terrain
check_box.name: formation_terrain_check
check_box.tool_tip: Optional: move each preview slot to land height. Leave off when placing on platforms or props

spinner.label: Edge gap
spinner.name: formation_edge_gap_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Minimum clear space between clone footprints in metres

spinner.label: Jitter
spinner.name: formation_jitter_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Maximum deterministic displacement in metres; clearance remains guaranteed

spinner.label: Files
spinner.name: brigade_columns_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Independent number of military files (columns)

spinner.label: Ranks
spinner.name: brigade_rows_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Independent number of military ranks (rows); count may leave the last rank partial

spinner.label: File gap
spinner.name: brigade_file_spacing_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Independent side-to-side spacing between files

spinner.label: Rank gap
spinner.name: brigade_rank_spacing_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Independent front-to-back spacing between ranks

spinner.label: Parameter
spinner.name: array_parameter_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Formation-specific parameter

button.name: reset_array_parameter
button.tool_tip: Reset this formation parameter

spinner.label: Seed
spinner.name: formation_seed_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Deterministic seed for Organic layouts and jitter

combo_box.name: formation_facing_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Heading resolved once into the placement draft

combo_box.name: crowd_create_mode_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Create one collapsed directing unit by default, or leave every clone separate

button.label: Pick facing point
button.name: btn_pick_facing_target
button.tool_tip: Set the selected prototype's fixed world-facing point before previewing

button.label: Preview in world
button.name: btn_array_build
button.tool_tip: Show every exact clone slot without creating anything yet

button.label: Confirm
button.name: btn_crowd_confirm
button.tool_tip: Create the exact visible preview

button.label: Unpin
button.name: btn_crowd_unpin
button.tool_tip: Return a pinned layout to following the mouse

button.label: Cancel
button.name: btn_crowd_cancel
button.tool_tip: Discard the placement draft without creating clones

combo_box.name: formation_overlay_palette_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: High-contrast colours for the in-world crowd preview markers and numbers (the dark outline is always kept)

panel.text: Ready. Select a clone, choose a formation, then Preview in world.
Wheel rotates · hold MMB and drag for height · click once pins · click again or Confirm creates · Alt camera · Esc cancels

combo_box.name: nameplate_mode_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Off hides clone labels; Smart shows one label for a collapsed group; All also labels expanded members

check_box.label: Edit group members
check_box.name: group_edit_members_check
check_box.tool_tip: Expand the selected group and allow member-local positioning

combo_box.name: lock_mode_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Behavior of the selected existing group; this does not set how a new crowd is created

check_box.label: Pin member offset
check_box.name: group_member_pinned_check
check_box.tool_tip: Keep this member's edited local offset when group authoring updates

button.label: Reset member
button.name: btn_group_member_reset
button.tool_tip: Restore this member's authored local transform inside the group

panel.name: motion_section

spinner.label: Frames
spinner.name: strip_count_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Number of successive real-time pose snapshots

button.name: reset_strip_count
button.tool_tip: Reset frame count to default

spinner.label: Interval
spinner.name: strip_interval_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Real seconds between captures. Formation and spacing come from the Crowd section

button.name: reset_strip_interval
button.tool_tip: Reset interval to default

button.label: Capture
button.name: btn_strip_start
button.tool_tip: Capture successive poses into the selected formation

button.label: Cancel
button.name: btn_strip_cancel
button.tool_tip: Stop this panel's active strip and keep snapshots already captured

combo_box.name: formation_motion_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Continuous transform motion for the current multi-selection; Off restores authored placement

spinner.label: Speed
spinner.name: formation_motion_speed
spinner.tool_tip: Cycles per second

button.name: reset_motion_speed
button.tool_tip: Reset motion speed to default

spinner.label: Amp
spinner.name: formation_motion_amplitude
spinner.tool_tip: Orbit multiplier, breathe radial fraction, or ripple height in metres

button.name: reset_motion_amplitude
button.tool_tip: Reset motion amplitude to default

button.label: Apply selection
button.name: btn_formation_motion_apply
button.tool_tip: Snapshot the selected ghosts' authored transforms and enable this group motion; choose Off to restore them

button.label: Group
button.name: btn_group_unit
button.tool_tip: Lock the selected ghosts as one directing unit

button.label: Ungroup
button.name: btn_ungroup_unit
button.tool_tip: Explicitly unlock the selected unit

spinner.label: Pose fps
spinner.name: pose_rate_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Per clone or group: 2-29 Hz holds poses for stop motion; 0 or 30 is smooth every frame

panel.text: Motion owns position. Keep-facing owns yaw except Spin. Chaos remains a stable additive variation.
